iucn_access: No API token available; user authorized use of available sources.
trophic_level_rule: Prefer DietTroph (diet-composition estimate), otherwise FoodTroph (food-item estimate); do not average methods. Keep both, SEs, remarks, stocks and evidence IDs.
trophic_group_rule: Preserve FishBase Herbivory2 broad feeding class separately from Atlantic reef diet guild. Neither field is inferred from body size, taxonomy, habitat or IUCN category. Do not infer a numeric level from guild.
functional_rule: Trait matrix with source-specific evidence, not a single inferred ecological role or functional-diversity score. Reef rafting is often genus-level and cannot be counted as observed species-level behavior.
iucn_rule: Use species-in-general FishBase stock records only; preserve category/date/taxon ID/assessment ID and provenance. N.E. in FishBase remains source-reported, not proof of current IUCN non-evaluation. No match or access failure is not NE, DD or LC. No regional assessment substitutes for global.
missing_values: Blank means unknown/not supplied, never non-migrant or trait absence. Source-coded zeros retained only for explicitly defined binary traits; FishBase habitat zeros not used as biological absences.
new_data_review: Machine-assisted compilation; independent scientific review pending.
